text:
I could only read one of the three roundups. Wired and Runner's World failed to load, so these picks come from SoundGuys. I haven't read any review of the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2.

**Top picks for running**
- **Soundcore AeroFit 2** is the best budget pick. SoundGuys lists it at about $80 on Amazon. It has adjustable ear hooks, an IP55 rating (sweat and dust resistant), multipoint connection and wireless charging. One owner reported about 6 hours of battery per charge against the 10 hours claimed, and the touch controls can be oversensitive.
- **Nothing Ear (Open)** is SoundGuys' best overall, at about $99. It has strong bass for an open design, an IP54 rating, long battery life and an EQ in the app.
- **Shokz OpenFit 2** is about $180. It has roughly 11 hours of battery and physical buttons, which are easier to use mid-run than touch controls. The **OpenFit 2+** is about $200 and has better call quality and less sound leakage.
- **HUAWEI FreeClip 2** is about $200. It's light and comfortable for long sessions and has an IP57 rating. Fit affects performance a lot, and it's pricey.
- **Sony LinkBuds Open** is about $158. It has about 9.5 hours of battery and good features, but it isn't built specifically for running.
- **Bose Ultra Open Earbuds** are about $299. SoundGuys lists them only as a notable mention, and they cost the most.

**My suggestion:** If you want one pair to start with, get the AeroFit 2. The ear hooks stay put better than clip-on designs, and it's the cheapest of these. If you want physical buttons and a secure fit, look at the OpenFit 2.

**Where to buy**
I didn't find verified direct product links for these. SoundGuys has Amazon links for every pick: https://www.soundguys.com/best-open-ear-headphones-and-earbuds-115102/

A deal site, Dealectric, claims the code AFSC20 takes the AeroFit 2 from $129.99 to $104 at Soundcore's store: https://dealectric.com/lab/V7/soundcore-aerofit-2. I couldn't verify that. Amazon's $80 price, as SoundGuys lists it, is lower anyway. SoundGuys also shows inconsistent list prices in places, so check the price at checkout.

If you tell me your budget, or whether you prefer bone conduction (Shokz OpenRun) to earbuds, I can narrow this down.

# Top Open-Ear Picks (per SoundGuys)

**Best overall: Nothing Ear (Open)**
- **Price:** $99.00 at Amazon (listed MSRP $149.00)
- **Pros:** Strong bass for an open design, customizable controls, parametric EQ in the companion app, IP54 rating, long battery life
- **Cons:** The page doesn't list any specific drawbacks.

**Best for iPhone: Apple AirPods 4**
- **Price:** $138.86 at Amazon (listed MSRP $119.00)
- **Pros:** Improved fit and comfort, H2 chip, Apple ecosystem integration, Adaptive EQ, IP54 rating
- **Cons:** One-size-fits-all design without swappable tips, so trying them on first is advised. One owner found the sound "extremely bright" without EQ adjustments.

**Best features: Sony LinkBuds Open**
- **Price:** $157.95 at Amazon (listed MSRP $229.99)
- **Pros:** Long battery life (about 9.5 hours), Auto Switch multi-point connection, wide-area tap controls, LE Audio/LC3 support on compatible Android devices
- **Cons:** Shares the typical sound-quality tradeoffs of open-ear earbuds.

**Best budget: Soundcore AeroFit 2**
- **Price:** $79.99 at Amazon (listed MSRP $99.99)
- **Pros:** Adjustable four-position ear hooks, IP55 rating, multipoint connection, 23 EQ presets, wireless charging
- **Cons:** Touch controls are very responsive, perhaps too much so. One owner reports about 6 hours per charge versus the 10 hours claimed.

**Best clip-on earbuds: HUAWEI FreeClip 2**
- **Price:** $199.99 at Amazon (MSRP $199.99)
- **Pros:** Lightweight, comfortable for long sessions, IP57 rating, strong battery life, either earbud works in either ear, above-average bass for a clip-on
- **Cons:** Expensive, fit strongly affects performance, and they don't block outside noise at all.

**Notable mentions**
- **Bose Ultra Open Earbuds:** $299 at Amazon (expensive clip-on option)
- **Shokz OpenFit 2+:** $199.95 at Amazon (strong call quality and reduced sound leakage)
- **Shokz OpenFit 2:** $179.95 at Amazon (about 11-hour battery life and physical buttons)
- **Anker Soundcore AeroFit (original):** $129.99 at Amazon (suited to outdoor fitness)

*Note: The page lists inconsistent prices in places (for example, AirPods 4 and Sony LinkBuds Open appear with different MSRPs in different sections), so check current prices before buying.*
